_comment: LDTD tower stats. range in blocks, cooldownTicks between shots (20 = 1 s), damage in half-hearts per hit. Cannon: splashRadius. Frost: slowAmplifier (0 = Slowness I) for slowTicks, hitting everything in range. Lantern: no shots; its core gives off full light, which weakens the Gloam. Edit, then run /ldtd reload.
